_meta.description: Approximate crop parameters for scoring. NOT verified facts: indicative values from FAO-style references, to be validated by a local agronomist (e.g. INRA Maroc / ORMVA Tadla).

scales.water_need_mm: crop water requirement over its growing season (mm), central value of the range
scales.heat_tolerance: 1 (very sensitive) .. 5 (very tolerant) to days with Tmax > 35 C during its season
scales.drought_tolerance: 1 (very sensitive) .. 5 (very tolerant) to dry spells and erratic rainfall
scales.nitrogen_effect: -1 = depletes soil N (needs fertiliser), 0 = neutral, +1 = fixes N (legume)
scales.soil_health_effect: -1 = degrades (low residue, heavy harvest traffic), 0 = neutral, +1 = improves (structure, cover, roots)
scales.season: oct-may = winter crop scored against the Oct-May season; year = perennial scored against the calendar year

durum_wheat.source: FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 33/56 (wheat 450-650 mm); adjusted downward for Moroccan rainfed/supplemental irrigation practice

barley.source: FAO crop information (barley); FAO Paper 56 Kc tables; barley known as most drought-tolerant small grain

faba_bean.source: FAO Paper 56 Kc tables (broad bean); FAO/ICARDA food legume references

chickpea.source: FAO Paper 56 Kc tables (chickpea); ICARDA chickpea references

sugar_beet.source: FAO crop water information: sugarbeet 550-750 mm; Tadla autumn-sown irrigated beet

alfalfa.source: FAO crop water information: alfalfa 800-1600 mm/year
